# Error Codes and Troubleshooting — Complete Architecture Guide

Comprehensive operational and internal analysis of Error Codes and Troubleshooting within MongoDB architectures.

## System Architecture & Invariants
- [HIGH] (core) Error Codes and Troubleshooting provides critical operational isolation and throughput guarantees.
- [HIGH] (antipatterns) Improper configuration of Error Codes and Troubleshooting causes query plan de-optimization under high concurrency.
